fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-29, a person promoting a trading group collected Rs. 8,00,000 from the complainant with an assurance of high returns. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-05-27 at approximately 11:50. The account reference SYN-ACC-100041 was noted in connection with the payment. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Gopal Mani, using the number 9000000457. A witness, Ramya Bai, reachable on 9000000232, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scheme reportedly promoted through a messaging group.
